purpose: Assistant-led rural commercial-maintenance provider expansion using direct statewide service claims and active Arizona government contract evidence.
safety: Inventory seed only. Does not promote vendors, alter trust ranking, stage outreach, or send outreach. State contract evidence is capability evidence, not a BMC endorsement.

records.category_label: Parking Lot Striping, Sealcoating & Pavement Maintenance
records.note: Direct company site states Arizona statewide asphalt striping and sealcoating services. Rural market is therefore in claimed statewide territory; BMC should still confirm mobilization/minimum-job terms before routing.

Direct company site says its pavement services are available to residential and commercial clients across Arizona and explicitly includes parking lots, repairs, sealcoating and striping. Confirm rural mobilization/minimums before routing.

records.category_label: Commercial Pressure Washing, Janitorial & Exterior Maintenance
records.business_name: Dirty's Power Washing and Cleaning Services, LLC
records.note: Direct company site labels its Arizona service area as statewide and lists power washing plus commercial cleaning/janitorial services. Confirm specific rural scheduling and travel terms before routing.

records.category_label: Commercial Pressure Washing & Facility Exterior Cleaning
records.note: Direct Arizona service-area page advertises statewide commercial pressure-washing contracts for property management, government, retail chains, fuel/convenience sites and shopping centers. Treat as territory claim requiring normal onboarding verification.

Official Arizona State Procurement Office record shows an ACTIVE Arizona DES contract for 'Janitorial Services - All Regions' through 2027-03-31. This is strong capability/coverage evidence, not proof of private-market availability; qualify before routing.

Official Arizona State Procurement Office record shows an ACTIVE Arizona DES contract for 'Janitorial Services - All Regions' through 2027-03-31. This indicates statewide-regional capability but private-market availability still requires BMC qualification.

Official Arizona State Procurement Office listing shows ACTIVE Department of Forestry and Fire Management contract CTR080083, 'Janitorial Services for Rural Areas,' through 2028-01-06. Rural-market suitability is supported by the award, but private-market availability must be qualified.
